content.what_it_is: Commented MATLAB generator for a centered 500x500 grid, 10 m annular water region, linearly sloped island/outer beach, and land capped at -2 m (L4-L47). It generates a ship path that expands from radius 60 to 250, measures step speed, plots depth and path, shifts ship coordinates into the grid-origin convention, and saves depth.txt and vessel_0001 (L49-L112).
entities: grid dimensions m and n defined at L5-L6
grid spacings dx and dy defined at L7-L8

coordinate grids X and Y defined at L13
figure dimensions wid and len defined at L16-L17
outer radius R1 and outer Slope defined at L22-L23
inner radius R2 and Slope_is defined at L25-L26
depth array dep initialized at L29 and modified at L36, L39, and L47
loop indices j and i defined at L32-L33
cell radius r defined at L34
initial route radius Rs and coordinates x0/y0 defined at L50-L52
nominal speed speed0 defined at L55
time vector t defined at L58

target radius Rship defined at L66
ramp time t0 defined at L69
trajectory loop index it defined at L72

unresolved: Comment/code mismatch and speed defect across L83-L94: the comment says angular speed is based on current radius, but omega divides by fixed Rship rather than rship. During the radial ramp, speed0 is therefore neither the tangential speed nor the total actual speed; actsp computes the discrepancy but is omitted from output at L108.

Comment/code scale mismatch at L105-L107: the stated shift is half a grid space, but the code adds half the full grid extent (m/2*dx and n/2*dy). The arithmetic matches conversion from centered coordinates to an origin at a grid corner, not the comment.
Potential orientation/interface defect at L58-L63 and L103-L107: row vectors t/xship/yship are assigned directly to vessel(:,k) column slices without transposition; no shape normalization is present.
Grid centering at L9-L10 yields even-sized ranges -500..498 rather than symmetric endpoints, so the chosen cell-center/edge convention remains ambiguous.
MATLAB pcolor at L98 ordinarily omits the final matrix row and column as colored faces; this affects the preview only.
